info.title: Project 0 Agent API
info.description: Agent-facing REST surface for the Project 0 lending protocol on Solana. All transaction endpoints return UNSIGNED base64 transactions — the caller's wallet signs; this service never holds keys. The same capabilities are available over MCP at POST /mcp.

get.summary: List lending banks with rates, sizes, weights, and e-mode

cached_at.description: Upstream snapshot time, unix ms — oldest of the composed rate/price sources. Names/symbols refresh on a slower (daily) cycle and do not count toward this age.

max_age_sec.description: Data is refreshed at most this often

address.description: Bank address (base58). Pass this as `bank` to action tools/endpoints.

price_usd.description: Oracle price in USD, decimal string. CAVEAT: for venue banks (Kamino/Drift/JupLend) this is currently the venue share-token (cToken) price, NOT the underlying token price — p0_get_positions and p0_get_wallet price the underlying, so the same mint can read differently here by the share exchange rate.

asset_tag.description: Asset class; "staked" banks are not actionable via this service in v1

operational_state.description: "Operational" | "Paused" | "ReduceOnly" (variants like "ReduceOnlyWithBorrowingPower" exist) — only Operational banks accept new deposits/borrows

deposit_apy_pct.description: Base deposit APY in percent (4.2 = 4.2% APY), venue-correct. For venue banks (Kamino/Drift/JupLend) this is the venue's own live rate model and moves with the venue's utilization — swings between reads reflect real venue rate movement.

utilization_pct.description: Utilization in percent (0-100). Describes the P0-side market — on venue banks it can read 0 while deposit_apy_pct is nonzero (yield is paid on the venue, not by P0 borrowers).

lending_emissions_apy_pct.description: Extra APY from active lending emissions, percent (0 when none)

borrowing_emissions_apy_pct.description: Emissions APY paid to borrowers, percent (0 when none)

available_liquidity_usd.description: Withdrawable/borrowable liquidity in the bank, USD decimal string

deposit_limit_usd.description: Deposit cap, USD decimal string; null = uncapped

borrow_limit_usd.description: Borrow cap, USD decimal string; null = uncapped

deposit_capacity_remaining_usd.description: Remaining room under the deposit cap, USD decimal string; null = uncapped

borrow_capacity_remaining_usd.description: Remaining room under the borrow cap, USD decimal string; null = uncapped

asset_weight_init.description: Initial collateral weight (0-1); deposits count at this fraction for new borrows

tag.description: This bank's e-mode tag. When this bank is used as COLLATERAL, this tag is what other banks' entries match via collateral_bank_emode_tag.

collateral_bank_emode_tag.description: e-mode tag of the collateral bank this override applies to

entries.description: Overrides that apply when BORROWING this bank: each entry names a collateral tag that gets the better weights. Empty = this bank grants no overrides as a borrow, but its tag may still unlock overrides on banks you borrow against it.

emode.description: E-mode weight overrides. Entries live on the borrow-side bank; a collateral-only bank (e.g. PT tokens) shows its tag with empty entries — look up the overrides on the bank you intend to borrow. null = no e-mode at all.

error.description: Prescriptive message: what broke and how to fix it

429.description: Rate limited; Retry-After header is set

get.summary: Ranked leveraged yield strategies, rate-arb and directional

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: stablecoins | sol_lst | sol | eth | btc | jlp

strategy_count.description: Total strategies matching the filter (before `limit` truncation)

direction.description: Directional exposure; null for rate-arbitrage loop strategies

supply_apy_pct.description: Total supply-leg APY in percent = supply_lending_apy_pct + supply_native_apy_pct + supply_emissions_apy_pct

borrow_apy_pct.description: Total borrow-leg cost APY in percent = borrow_lending_apy_pct + borrow_native_apy_pct + borrow_emissions_apy_pct

supply_lending_apy_pct.description: Bank lending-rate portion of the supply APY (the venue's utilization-driven rate; derived, so ±0.01pp rounding)

borrow_lending_apy_pct.description: Bank borrow-rate portion of the borrow APY (derived, so ±0.01pp rounding)

supply_native_apy_pct.description: Native (e.g. staking) yield portion of the supply APY

borrow_native_apy_pct.description: Native yield portion of the borrow APY

supply_emissions_apy_pct.description: Emissions portion of the supply APY

borrow_emissions_apy_pct.description: Emissions portion of the borrow APY

max_leverage.description: Maximum achievable leverage for this pair

available_strategy_size_usd.description: Remaining deployable capacity for this strategy, USD decimal string

capacity_is_estimate.description: true when capacity is a proxy estimate rather than an exact figure

emode_applied.description: Whether e-mode weight overrides apply to this pair

capacity_adjusted_score.description: Ranking score (higher = better yield weighted by deployable size) — the list is sorted by this. A NEGATIVE score means the strategy loses money at the scored leverage; entries with negative net APY at every leverage level are returned for completeness — never execute them expecting positive yield.

error.description: Prescriptive message: what broke and how to fix it

429.description: Rate limited; Retry-After header is set

get.summary: Wallet token holdings with USD values

cached_at.description: Read time, unix ms. Balances are fetched fresh from RPC; prices/metadata are at most 60s old.

total_value_usd.description: Value of the bank-oracle-priced holdings only, USD decimal string. When unpriced_token_count > 0 this is a PARTIAL total — the unpriced holdings' value is unknown, not zero.

unpriced_token_count.description: How many held tokens have no maintained price (excluded from total_value_usd)

mint.description: Token mint (base58). Native SOL is reported under the wrapped-SOL mint with is_native_sol=true.

symbol.description: From Project 0 bank metadata; "" for tokens not listed on the protocol

is_native_sol.description: true for the native SOL balance entry (a wrapped-SOL token account shares the mint with false here)

amount_ui.description: Balance in UI token units (1.5 = 1.5 tokens)

amount_base_units.description: Exact balance in base units (integer string)

price_usd.description: Token price in USD, decimal string

value_usd.description: Position value in USD, decimal string

price_source.description: "bank_oracle" = mint has a Project 0 bank with a live oracle (any operational state), priced identically to p0_get_positions; "unpriced" = mint is not listed, or its only banks are wind-down banks with admin-fixed placeholder prices — the balance is real but its value is UNKNOWN, not zero

tokens.description: Sorted by value_usd descending. Tokens not listed on Project 0 appear with empty symbol/name and price_source "unpriced" — their value is unknown, not zero.

error.description: Prescriptive message: what broke and how to fix it

429.description: Rate limited; Retry-After header is set

get.summary: Positions, health, and capacity (fresh on-chain compute)

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address (returns all its accounts) or marginfi account address

parameters.name: borrow_bank
parameters.description: Bank address to compute max borrow for

computed_at.description: Computation time, unix ms — account state is fetched fresh from RPC

oracle_max_age_sec.description: Market context (banks/prices) is at most this old

resolved_as.description: "account" = query was a marginfi account address; "authority" = query was a wallet, all its accounts are returned

address.description: Marginfi account address (base58). SAVE THIS — action tools take it as `account`.

authority.description: The wallet that owns this account

status.description: healthy >0.5, moderate 0.1-0.5, warning 0.01-0.1, critical <=0.01; liquidation occurs at 0. Meaningful only when the account holds positions — an EMPTY account reads "healthy" with health_factor null.

health_factor.description: (maint assets - maint liabilities) / maint assets; 1 = no debt, 0 = liquidatable. null = the account has no assets (empty account): there is nothing at risk, but do not compare null against the numeric bands.

free_collateral_usd.description: Initial-weighted borrowing power remaining, USD decimal string

net_apy_pct.description: Blended APY across all positions, percent (negative = paying more than earning)

emode_active.description: Whether e-mode weight overrides are currently active

bank.description: Bank address (base58) — pass as `bank` to action tools

amount_ui.description: Position size in UI token units of the underlying

amount_usd.description: Position value in USD, decimal string

apy_pct.description: Current APY for this side, percent (earned for lend, paid for borrow). For venue banks (Kamino/Drift/JupLend) this is the venue's own rate; 0 may mean the rate feed was temporarily unavailable.

liquidation_price_usd.description: Price of this asset at which the account becomes liquidatable; null when not applicable (e.g. no debt)

max_withdraw_ui.description: For lend positions: how much can be withdrawn right now (health-, liquidity-, and venue-capped — the same math the withdraw builder enforces). null for borrow positions.

max_borrow_ui.description: Max borrowable now in UI units — same math the borrow builder enforces (0.92 volatility factor)

max_borrow.description: Populated only when a borrow_bank was passed in the request

accounts.description: Empty when the wallet has no marginfi account yet — create one to start

error.description: Prescriptive message: what broke and how to fix it

429.description: Rate limited; Retry-After header is set

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null = no more

amount_ui.description: Amount in UI token units, decimal string

amount_usd.description: USD value at the time, decimal string; null when unpriced

post.description: Returns UNSIGNED base64 v0 transactions — sign with the authority wallet and submit in array order. transactions[action_tx_index] is the main action; earlier entries are oracle cranks. The blockhash expires in ~60s; rebuild if expired. simulation.post_health is the account's health after the action. `submit` tells you how: "sequential" = one at a time in order; "bundle" = ALL transactions signed with the returned blockhash and submitted together as ONE atomic Jito bundle (loop / close-position may require this).

authority.description: The wallet that will own and sign for the new account
The wallet that must SIGN and submit (echoed)

account.description: The marginfi account acted on (or to be created). SAVE THIS for subsequent calls.

bank.description: Bank acted on (echoed); null for create_account

amount_ui.description: Amount in UI token units (echoed)

submit.description: How to submit: "sequential" = sign and send in array order, waiting for each to confirm; "bundle" = ALL transactions must be signed with the returned blockhash and submitted together as ONE atomic Jito bundle — sending them one by one will fail or leave a half-open position

leverage.description: Target leverage for loop actions; null otherwise

amount_ui.description: Amount in UI token units for this leg
Amount in UI token units for this leg

legs.description: Per-leg sizing for flash-loan actions (loop / close_position); null otherwise

provider.description: Aggregator that won the route, e.g. "JUPITER" or "TITAN"

in_amount_ui.description: Swap input in UI units of the input token

min_out_amount_ui.description: Guaranteed minimum output after slippage — the deposit is sized to this

swap.description: Swap route inside the flash loan; null when no swap

bridge_mint.description: Set when the loop had to route through a bridge token (two-hop); null otherwise

post.summary: Unwind a loop: withdraw, swap, repay in one flash loan
post.description: Returns UNSIGNED base64 v0 transactions — sign with the authority wallet and submit in array order. transactions[action_tx_index] is the main action; earlier entries are oracle cranks. The blockhash expires in ~60s; rebuild if expired. simulation.post_health is the account's health after the action. `submit` tells you how: "sequential" = one at a time in order; "bundle" = ALL transactions signed with the returned blockhash and submitted together as ONE atomic Jito bundle (loop / close-position may require this).

parameters.name: x-jupiter-api-key
parameters.description: Bring-your-own Jupiter API key for this build (overrides the service key). Never put keys in the body.

parameters.name: x-titan-api-key
parameters.description: Bring-your-own Titan API key for this build (overrides the service key).

deposit_bank.description: Collateral bank to withdraw from (the loop's deposit_bank)

borrow_bank.description: Debt bank to repay (the loop's borrow_bank)

amount.description: Debt to repay in borrow-token UI units; required unless repay_all

authority.description: The wallet that must SIGN and submit (echoed)

account.description: The marginfi account acted on (or to be created). SAVE THIS for subsequent calls.

bank.description: Bank acted on (echoed); null for create_account

amount_ui.description: Amount in UI token units (echoed)

submit.description: How to submit: "sequential" = sign and send in array order, waiting for each to confirm; "bundle" = ALL transactions must be signed with the returned blockhash and submitted together as ONE atomic Jito bundle — sending them one by one will fail or leave a half-open position

leverage.description: Target leverage for loop actions; null otherwise

amount_ui.description: Amount in UI token units for this leg
Amount in UI token units for this leg

legs.description: Per-leg sizing for flash-loan actions (loop / close_position); null otherwise

provider.description: Aggregator that won the route, e.g. "JUPITER" or "TITAN"

in_amount_ui.description: Swap input in UI units of the input token

min_out_amount_ui.description: Guaranteed minimum output after slippage — the deposit is sized to this

swap.description: Swap route inside the flash loan; null when no swap

bridge_mint.description: Set when the loop had to route through a bridge token (two-hop); null otherwise

base64.description: UNSIGNED base64-encoded Solana v0 transaction — sign with the authority wallet and submit

type.description: Machine tag for this transaction's role, e.g. "CRANK", "DEPOSIT"

transactions.description: Sign and submit per `submit`: in array order (sequential) or as one atomic bundle

action_tx_index.description: Index of the main action tx; earlier entries are oracle cranks that must land first

last_valid_block_height.description: Transactions expire past this block height (~60s) — rebuild if expired
